screens.name: Marketing root <head> metadata — no new visual surface
components: none — this story adds an HTML <head> meta tag, not a UI component; no design-focx/design-connect component is added, removed, or modified
screens.notes: This story has zero visual footprint: it duplicates already-published copy into a non-rendering <meta name="description"> tag. The Figma reference cited is the same Cover frame (9:7) the existing hero already maps to (per figma.manifest.json's sync log) — there is no separate Figma node for document metadata, and none is invented. The token cited, focx.style.ui-subheading, is the typography style that already governs the visible subheading text being duplicated verbatim into the meta tag; it establishes that the copy is the exact published string, not new or paraphrased marketing copy. No component is consumed because no UI is built. designSystemGaps is empty: the design system fully supports this change by requiring nothing new from it.
